test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

When scaling the Himalayas, the higher one ascends, __the lesser oxygen is available__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the less oxygen is available**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**the lesser oxygen is available**" in the original sentence is incorrect because "lesser" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• The correct comparative form of "less" to describe a decreasing quantity is simply "**less**."
 
• The sentence is describing a comparison between
